Class StationRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.StationRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class StationRepository extends Object implements Serializable
Thread-safe repository for storing and querying Station instances.

Provides methods to add, get, and remove stations safely across threads.

    • copyFrom

      public void copyFrom(StationRepository other)
      Copies all stations from another StationRepository into this repository. Clears the current repository and replaces its contents with a defensive copy of the stations retrieved from the specified repository.
      Parameters:
      other - the StationRepository to copy stations from
